title: The Good Docs Project templates v1.1
description: Requires `type` and recommends the 25 template slugs that The Good Docs Project publishes (upstream templates repo, main as of 2026-08-09). Any other non-empty string names a page type TGDP does not publish, and passes. Stack tgdp:templates-strict:1.1 beside it to close `type` to the 25 slugs. Adopting it states that every page has a type, so an untyped page is a gap. Diataxis classifies what a page *is* on the same key, so a page under both has to satisfy both. Pick one. It composes freely with a schema keyed on a different field, such as passo-uno:seven-action:1.0. See https://www.thegooddocsproject.dev/template

type.description: Which page type this page is, as a Good Docs Project template slug where one fits. The 25 slugs are the recommended values. The Core pack is `concept`, `how-to`, `readme`, `reference`, `release-notes`, `troubleshooting` and `tutorial`. The rest come from the Community and Misc packs. Any other non-empty string names a page type TGDP does not publish.
